people.name: Mr. Rajiv Dube
people.bio: Currently, Mr. Dube is an Independent Director on Boards, an advisory board member and professor of practice at the Deakin Business School, Melbourne and a senior advisor to firms in India and Australia. Over 40 years of multi-sector experience, having served at the highest echelons of two Indian conglomerates - Tata and Aditya Birla. An engineer and a post-graduate in Business Management.

people.name: Ms. Kalpana Merchant
people.bio: She has been associated with, and has been a partner at, Kanga & Co., AZB & Partners and Jerome Merchant + Partners. Over 45 years of experience in the legal profession. She holds a Bachelor of Laws degree and a Bachelor of Arts degree with a major in Psychology and is a qualified solicitor.
